verdict.rationale: A document-processing SaaS with a web UI could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows AI-powered processing features: an "agentic" parse tier, custom parsing prompts, prompt-generated extraction schemas, and natural-language classification rules. It also shows an MCP endpoint for external agents. None of this documents a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to inside the product.
